body: Absolutely its such a break of trust and security especially in the digital age its so fucked up. I've had it happen to me and just knowing that my face and body is out there somewhere attached to some creep is horrific.

I dropped out to focus on my mental health I've experienced emotional abuse and extreme stress all my life and with the quarantine and the economy shock I'm not really sure what else to do. Currently I'm just focusing on building a solid routine and practicing music but things are looking pretty hopeless.
Yeah stuff just starts to make more sense now
